title.en: MALACAÑANG GRANTING GOVERNMENT HOSPITALS AND THE BUREAU OF FOOD AND DRUGS AUTONOMY IN THE USE OF THEIR INCOME

text.en:
Any income earned by any government hospital
and by the BFD shall be deemed to have been released from appropria-
tions authorized for such hospital or the BFD, as the case may be, and
shall be immediately available for expenditures.

Fund releases from the Department of Budget and
Management shall be reduced by the amount of income earned by the
hospitals and the BFD. For this purpose, these agencies shall submit
periodic reports of their income as well as reports indicating the details
of expenditures thereof.

In the event that any of these agencies realizes
income more than its authorized appropriation, such excess shall be
deemed automatically appropriated and released to augment existing
authorized appropriation.

- 2 -
The rules and regulations necessary to implement
the provisions of this Executive Order shall be jointly issued by the
Department of Finance and the Department of Budget and Management.

This Executive Order shall take effect immediately.
Done in the City of Manila on 25th of
Year of Our Lord, Nineteen Hundred and Eighty Seven.
By authority of the President:
POKER P. ARROYO
Executive Secretary
